# Eastern OS

> Eastern OS is a reflective decision-support product: multi-turn dialogue, a decision report you can reopen, and optional 30-day same-line reminders. We advise; you decide. Not medical, legal, financial, or fortune-telling advice. For adults 18+.

Eastern OS (easternos.com) helps people get unstuck on consequential decisions using AI dialogue grounded in Eastern analytical models. Purchase uses PASS credits. Legal policy bodies are English; UI chrome is available in English, 中文, Español, and Français.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.easternos.com/): Marketing landing and entry
- [Pivot dialogue](https://www.easternos.com/poju): Multi-turn decision dialogue (product route)
- [Glyph](https://www.easternos.com/glyph): Short reflective draw
- [Syncro](https://www.easternos.com/syncro): Rhythm / timing companion
- [Match](https://www.easternos.com/match): Two-profile relationship lens
- [Workspace app](https://www.easternos.com/app): Signed-in workbench
